text:
maria: :warning: az1 proxy pool (proxy-az1-*) showing sustained degradation, eviction rate ~40% over last 6m. P99 token latencies spike and many 502s upstream. Suggest emergency per-customer soft limits while we stabilize.
samir: seeing a ton of upstream timeouts to redis and gRPC resets. p95 token throughput down 30%. logs show repeated `connection reset by peer` for proxy instances.
kevin: ok. do we want broad softcap or targeted by tenant group? we can push a route-level per-customer throttle quickly.
anya: if we do broad caps, we should exclude enterprise orgs and internal infra. they rely on SLOs.
jordan: +1 to targeted. can we whitelist enterprise and critical customers, apply a softcap to the rest? start small and scale if needed.
maria: prioritize stability over perfect fairness. proposal: apply per-customer token rps limit 8rps with burst 40 for non-enterprise in az1, monitor 5m, then adjust. also enable fallback to az2 for eligible workloads.
samir: capacity in az2 is already ~70% used, can't failover everyone. we can route non-priority routes to az2 and keep priority on az1.
kevin: I'll prepare a policy patch. snippet I can push via ops-config:
```
route_policy:
  region: az1
  match: "tenant.priority != high and tenant.tier != enterprise"
  per_customer_rate_limit: 8rps
  burst: 40
  rollout: canary 5% -> 20% -> 100% (5m checks)
```
jordan: let's canary at 5% and watch p99 and error rate. if error_rate drops and eviction_count drops, expand.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2347 — az1 proxy degradation detected. Runbook: proxy-pool-degrade-v2 triggered.
maria: kevin assign to you to apply the canary. samir please update evictions dashboard and set alert for eviction_count > 10/min. anya notify top 20 customers about potential degraded throughput and fallback behavior. jordan monitor canary and call rollback if latency increases > 10%.
kevin: applying canary now to 5% of traffic for non-enterprise tenants in az1.
deploy-bot: policy apply job started (job id: 8a3f). rolling out canary to 5%.
kevin: canary deployed. verifying metrics.
jordan: initial 1m after canary: eviction_count down 12%, p99 tokens down 18%, overall error rate down slightly. good signal.
maria: expand to 20% in 10m if metrics hold. keep enterprise exclusion.
samir: setting temporary alert thresholds and extending log retention for az1 for easier triage.
anya: sending customer advisory email now to top 20 with recommended mitigations and contact for escalation.
kevin: expanding rollout to 20%.
deploy-bot: policy apply job succeeded (job id: 8a3f). rollout at 20%.
jordan: 20% looks stable. eviction_count improved 25% since start of incident. no customer escalations yet.
maria: good. leave caps in place and schedule 1h re-eval. we'll only remove after pod count stable and eviction rate <5% for 30m.
kevin: noted. I've added a rollback handle: `per_customer_rate_limit: unlimited` can be applied to revert.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2347 updated: severity -> high, assigned to eng-sre.
maria: thanks all. next steps: samir follow up on root cause (node-level kernel timeouts?), kevin keep policy until we see recovery, anya continue customer comms. i'll update incident doc.
jordan: I'll watch dashboards and post if anything regresses.
maria: closing loop for now — keeping thread open for updates. :white_check_mark:
